title: Easy run 72min + strides, PM spin 50min Z2
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: AM 60min at 142-152bpm, then 6x20s strides (1m40 jog). PM indoor spin 50min at 134-147bpm, cadence 90+.
GYM: none.
FUEL: normal.
GARMIN: run ~80, spin ~55.
STOP RULE: run HR over 155 on flat = slow down, not push. Poor sleep (<6h) = drop the spin.
WHY: aerobic volume with zero impact cost from the spin.
